body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 06de19b19aaefdb906fb02f28bd2d54678fde039 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks to austin62jake for the original change (#296).

**What looks good**
- View state only: `State::post_refusal` (state.rs:1159) is never saved and changes no project data, so no command is needed. It is set only on a refused post (state.rs:3711-3722), and cleared by the window's close button, a successful post (3683), New/Open (2391, 3625).
- An edit after the refusal does not close the window. It notes that the document has changed since (post_refusal.rs, `doc_version` compare), so a stale reason is not shown as current.
- No unwrap/expect/panic in non-test code; the few in tests/post_refusal.rs are test-only. Provenance line present. post_refusal.rs is 78 lines. The window draws nothing when there is no refusal, so existing snapshots do not move. Decision file is in place (docs/decisions/265-sticky-post-refusal.md). The PR touches no build.rs, .github, scripts or dependencies.
- Merge resolution checked: the PR's diff against main is only the #265 content (7 files). `post_refusal` sits next to main's `machines_pane` in mod.rs and `gcode_viewer` in tests.rs; shell.rs and state.rs carry both sides. Nothing from main was dropped.

**Local results (merged with main, targeted per request; not the full suites)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- post_refusal machines_pane gcode_viewer post_file` (CWD crates/ui) | 14 passed, 0 failed (4 post_refusal, 3 machines_pane, 2 gcode_viewer, 5 post_file) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- state.rs is already far over 400 lines; this adds about 25 more (existing debt).
- The PR body ends `Refs #265`, so #265 stays open on merge. Is that intended?

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
